test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the following digit-letter-symbol series carefully and answer the question that follows.

Np4@8cQ9%6TkF3=5g4&RwJX

Which character is 5th to the right of the 18th character from the right end?
solution:
**Given: **Np4@8cQ9%6TkF3=5g4&RwJX

**Explanation:**

First we have to count 18th character from the right end

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9384ad862f817382c0ceb9a044659603a9aef37cfa35c9d0860dd5df37580ec8.png] 

Next, we have 5th to the right, as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2bd4368b2fce936b494e0cfd25d19e47224fdbfac9c69c8837e5b32ca7b2265.png] 

Thus, character **'T'** is 5th to the right of the 18th character from the right end.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'option 2'.**
